policy: Research profiles only; no execution/production/adoption authority

profiles.birth: A paid product choice with independently repeated specific buyer defect, correctable reader-choice advantage and plausible encounter/switch route. Paid demand remains a separate evidence facet.
profiles.stop: Generic low rating, one complaint, adequate substitute, unsupported format fit or no encounter route.
profiles.motivation_scope: Practical, entertainment, gift, identity and aesthetic reading motives are all eligible.

profiles.birth: Independent repeated buyer need or reading/social/identity motive plus current workaround or expenditure and identifiable payer; select product only after format/payment fit.
profiles.stop: One viral discussion, correlated authors, free interest without reason to pay, absent format or payer.
profiles.motivation_scope: Jobs can be emotional/social/aesthetic as well as functional; no utilitarian-only gate.

profiles.birth: Readership x reading motivation x book market x reader promise x channel; concrete existing paid market before product proposal.
profiles.stop: No credible reader promise, unsupported route, rights failure or insufficient independent market evidence.
profiles.motivation_scope: Fiction, gifts, identity and pleasure eligible; method profile does not replace the historical v5 scorer.

profiles.birth: An object/work/theme plus identifiable audience and reading motive suggests an underserved format/language/edition with a plausible paid encounter route.
profiles.stop: Portfolio hindsight, mere repackaging without reader value, unresolved rights or lack of payment mechanism.
profiles.motivation_scope: Object/audience challenger retained; previous shadow results do not validate this version.
